sections.text: ETV6::NTRK3 is a transforming fusion associated with secretory breast carcinoma. Expression in mammary epithelial cell lines produced transformation and experimental tumors.

sections.text: Larotrectinib targets oncogenic NTRK-fusion-positive advanced solid tumors in adults and children without known acquired TRK resistance mutations, after progression or without satisfactory alternatives, when disease is metastatic or surgery would cause severe morbidity.

audit_evidence.scope: NTRK fusion without known acquired resistance; metastatic or surgery severe morbidity; prior progression/no satisfactory alternative.

report_comment.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain. NTRK3 encodes TRKC, a neurotrophin receptor tyrosine kinase. ETV6::NTRK3 is a transforming fusion associated with secretory breast carcinoma. Expression in mammary epithelial cell lines produced transformation and experimental tumors. Larotrectinib targets oncogenic NTRK-fusion-positive advanced solid tumors in adults and children without known acquired TRK resistance mutations, after progression or without satisfactory alternatives, when disease is metastatic or surgery would cause severe morbidity.
